title: Quantitative Assessment of Intersectional Empathetic Bias and Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of sexuality descriptors into masked prompt templates to measure variance in the model's empathetic understanding, affective empathy (VAD scores), and response appropriateness (EPITOME scores).
Counterfactual substitution of pronouns into masked prompt templates to evaluate how differences in gender identity affect the empathy metrics of the generated responses.
Randomized counterfactual substitution of racial group identifiers into conversational prompt templates to assess intersectional variance in model empathy.
Randomized counterfactual substitution of education levels into prompt templates to measure fluctuations in the model's cognitive and affective empathy.
Randomized counterfactual substitution of religious identities into conversational contexts to evaluate the stability of empathetic understanding across different groups.
Randomized substitution of age attributes into masked templates to assess variance in empathetic response appropriateness.
Randomized insertion of socio-economic status descriptors into prompt templates to evaluate intersectional biases in the empathetic capabilities of language models.
